title: REQ · node_modules/phaser lock entry resolves 3.90.0 with URL and integrity
summary: node_modules/phaser lock entry is version 3.90.0 with matching URL, integrity and dependencies
description: Context: node_modules/phaser (L3445-L3453) is 4.2.1 with eventemitter3 ^5.0.4. Desired: version 3.90.0, tarball URL, integrity from the registry and eventemitter3 ^5.0.1. Expected: npm ci installs 3.90.0. Why: reproducible installs on the pinned engine.
acceptance_criteria: Given package-lock.json, when node_modules/phaser is read, then version is 3.90.0 and resolved is https://registry.npmjs.org/phaser/-/phaser-3.90.0.tgz.
Given the entry, when integrity is read, then it is the 3.90.0 sha512 hash and dependencies.eventemitter3 is ^5.0.1.
technical_constraints: Integrity must be the registry value for phaser@3.90.0
